EMUsort (O'Connell et al. 2026): high-density intramuscular arrays, motor units

```text
dspk sort emusort [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT> <RECORDING>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<RECORDING>`**  
  Recording (SpikeGLX .bin / .cbin, raw .bin + JSON .meta, NWB, Zarr)

**Settings**

- **`--source <SOURCE>`**  
  Source within the file (an id `dspk-cli open` lists); default: the largest electrical one
- **`--probe <PROBE>`**: one of `neuropixels1`, `neuropixels2`, `tetrode`, `utah`, `hdemg4x8`, `hdemg8x8`  
  Probe preset; default: the geometry the recording carries (SpikeGLX), else an error
- **`--probe-file <PROBE_FILE>`**  
  Probe file (.json: probeinterface or Kilosort 4) saying which channel each contact is wired to: the data is read in contact order (unconnected contacts left out), with its geometry
- **`--progress <PROGRESS>`**: default `bar`, one of `bar`, `json`  
  How progress is reported: `bar` (on stderr) or `json` (one JSON object per line on stdout: `progress` events, then `done` or `error`; for programs running this one)
- **`--channel-map <CHANNEL_MAP>`**  
  Channel map (.toml / .json, pairs under `remap`) applied after the probe: channels reordered, dropped, renamed; the geometry follows them
- **`--pitch-um <PITCH_UM>`**: default `8000`  
  Electrode pitch of HD-EMG grid presets (µm)
- **`--start-sec <START_SEC>`**: default `0`  
  Start of the part to process (s)
- **`--duration-sec <DURATION_SEC>`**  
  Length of the part to process (s); default: to the end
- **`-o, --output <OUTPUT>`**  
  Output folder or store
- **`--format <FORMAT>`**  
  Output format; default: from the name (`.nwb.zarr` → nwb, other `.zarr` → zarr, else phy)
  - `phy`: Phy / Kilosort folder (`.npy` arrays, `.tsv` tables)
  - `zarr`: dspk `.sorting.zarr` store
  - `nwb`: NWB `/units` table in a `.nwb.zarr` store
- **`--templates <TEMPLATES>`**  
  Predefined universal templates (`.npz` with `wPCA`, `wTEMP`) when --templates-from-data false
- **`--show-config`**  
  Print every setting of the run and exit
- **`--nt <NT>`**: default `61`  
  Samples per waveform (odd); 61 is 2 ms at 30 kHz
- **`--nt-ms <NT_MS>`**  
  Waveform length in ms (overrides --nt: rounded to an odd sample count for the recording)
- **`--nt0min <NT0MIN>`**  
  Sample a waveform's trough is aligned to; default: int(20 · nt / 61)
- **`--th-universal <TH_UNIVERSAL>`**: default `9`  
  Universal-template detection threshold (whitened σ)
- **`--th-learned <TH_LEARNED>`**: default `8`  
  Learned-template matching threshold (whitened σ)
- **`--th-single-ch <TH_SINGLE_CH>`**: default `6 9 12 15`  
  Single-channel thresholds of the clips templates are learned from (whitened σ), comma-separated
- **`--templates-from-data <TEMPLATES_FROM_DATA>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Learn the universal templates from the recording (false: Kilosort4's predefined ones, from --templates or downloaded through dspk-hub)
- **`--n-templates <N_TEMPLATES>`**: default `9`  
  Universal templates learned
- **`--n-pcs <N_PCS>`**: default `9`  
  Principal components per channel
- **`--nskip <NSKIP>`**: default `2`  
  Every nskip-th batch is used for template learning
- **`--do-car <DO_CAR>`**: default `false`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Common average reference before filtering
- **`--do-bandpass <DO_BANDPASS>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Butterworth band-pass (order 3 per edge, zero phase); false: no Butterworth
- **`--bandpass-low-hz <BANDPASS_LOW_HZ>`**: default `300`  
  Lower band edge (Hz)
- **`--bandpass-high-hz <BANDPASS_HIGH_HZ>`**: default `5000`  
  Upper band edge (Hz), below Nyquist; 0: no upper edge (a high-pass)
- **`--do-notch <DO_NOTCH>`**: default `false`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Line-noise notch after the band
- **`--notch-hz <NOTCH_HZ>`**: default `60`  
  Notch frequency (Hz; 50 outside the Americas)
- **`--notch-q <NOTCH_Q>`**: default `30`  
  Quality factor of the notch (bandwidth = notch / Q)
- **`--whitening-range <WHITENING_RANGE>`**: default `32`  
  Channels in each local whitening neighbourhood
- **`--batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>`**: default `60000`  
  Samples per batch
- **`--max-peels <MAX_PEELS>`**: default `50`  
  Matching-pursuit rounds per window
- **`--global-merges <GLOBAL_MERGES>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Merge units whose waveforms are alike and whose spikes are mutually refractory
- **`--merge-similarity <MERGE_SIMILARITY>`**: default `0.5`  
  Waveform similarity (correlation over lags) a pair needs to be tested for a merge
- **`--duplicate-spike-ms <DUPLICATE_SPIKE_MS>`**: default `0.25`  
  A unit's spikes within this many ms of its previous spike are removed (0 keeps them)
- **`--reproducible <REPRODUCIBLE>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Same input on the same device gives the same spikes
- **`--remove-channel-delays <REMOVE_CHANNEL_DELAYS>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Estimate and remove per-channel delays (up to 2 ms)
- **`--remove-spike-outliers <REMOVE_SPIKE_OUTLIERS>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Remove outlier clips (HDBSCAN) before learning the universal templates
- **`--hdbscan-min-cluster-size <HDBSCAN_MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE>`**: default `20`  
  HDBSCAN min_cluster_size of the outlier removal
